verdict.rationale: Simular's Sai is a computer-use agent that carries out plain-language tasks on cloud or local machines, so in-product AI insights from user data is a fair question to ask of it. However, no evidence shows a documented feature that analyzes the user's data and surfaces insights or suggestions inside the product. The community Calendar-to-Docs digest script and workflow-template success rates are a user-built automation and adjacent metadata, so they earn no credit.
